name: Yureru Bus Guide ~Oppai ga Ippai~
original_name: 揺れるバスガイド～おっぱいがいっぱい～
source:
Shugo works at a bus company, but his company gets wobbly due to deep recession. One day, boss of the company suddenly passes away in an accident. Employees leave one by one and there are only four workers left. They try to collect as much money as possible from banks and one bank sets down a strict condition to them. That is to give customers sexual services.... Shugo asks his bus guides to accept it for the company....

[From ErogeShop]
